title.narrative: prévention de l'insécurité et l'extrémisme violent et conception d'un portefeuille intégré en Mauritanie, y compris sur les entreprises et les droits de l'homme

description.narrative: The Security 4 Peace Global Flagship funding window support in this second round aims to deliver safety and security for people in crisis and fragile contexts, addressing urgent needs in countries like Libya, Ethiopia, Mauritania, Burundi, Sri Lanka and Pakistan (and potentially Bangladesh). This initiative focuses on human rights and business and human rights for prevention and risk anticipation/management, including dealing with past human rights violations and transitional justice and addressing new violations and conflicts, as well as enhancing justice and security systems and fostering community resilience. Delivered through the Global Programme for the Rule of Law, this support strengthens national and local capacities, enables development approaches in fragile settings and enables people-centred approaches. It seeks to build inclusive, effective institutions that respond to the human rights and security and justice needs of all, particularly those most impacted by the crises and left behind. The funding window aligns with global development priorities, including SDG 16 (Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions) and SDG 5 (Gender Equality), aiming to create stable environments where communities can thrive.
